subject.title: Feature request: config option to suppress sub-agent announce

question: Which public contract should own deterministic sub-agent completion suppression: a narrow per-spawn delivery mode, global/per-channel configuration, or a unified routing contract that also includes parent delivery?
rationale: The missing behavior is proven, but each option creates a different public API, configuration, ownership, and upgrade surface; repository policy sets a high bar for new config and does not authorize automation to choose among these product semantics.

options.title: Per-spawn mode
options.body: Expose a closed `sessions_spawn` completion mode with current delivery as the default and deterministic skip as an opt-in, deferring defaults and channel policy.

options.title: Config policy
options.body: Add global and possibly per-channel defaults, accepting a broader configuration and precedence contract.

options.title: Unified routing
options.body: Design skip, requester delivery, and parent wake-up together with https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/27445 before exposing a public control.

recommendation.title: Per-spawn mode
recommendation.body: Expose a closed `sessions_spawn` completion mode with current delivery as the default and deterministic skip as an opt-in, deferring defaults and channel policy.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history trail covers the original completion-message guarantees and the later unified announce pipeline that this decision would change.
